_readme: Hand-maintained context window table (PRD Q2, P0-8). Values are total context window in tokens.
Keys are matched against the model id from the wire (e.g. 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001') by
exact match first, then LONGEST PREFIX match. So 'claude-haiku-4-5' covers every dated build.
A model with no entry resolves to UNKNOWN. That is deliberate: the gauge must show a token
count with no percentage and a gray dial rather than guess a window and render a wrong
percentage. Do not add a catch-all default here — that would defeat P0-8.
VERIFY BEFORE TRUSTING: these are the standard published windows for each family. Two caveats.
(1) Sonnet 4 and 4.5 support a 1M-token window behind a beta header; if you enable it, the
effective window is 1000000 and the entry below is wrong for that session.
(2) Models newer than this file are intentionally absent rather than guessed. Add them once
you have confirmed the number from the docs, not from memory.
default to a 1M window per the Claude API docs and carry explicit keys above so they
never fall back to an older family's 200k prefix. Verified live: an Opus 4.8 session
read 37.8% against the wrong 200k prefix before these keys existed.
